title: Lorentz regauging of Maxwell's quaternions

tellings.quote: back in the late early 1900s, Heinrich Lorentz, he did something that was called symmetrical regauging of Maxwell's quaternions, because Maxwell

plain: In the early 1900s, the physicist Hendrik Lorentz is said to have carried out what Dave Rossi calls a "symmetrical regauging" of James Clerk Maxwell's equations of electricity and magnetism. Maxwell had written those equations in quaternions, a four-part kind of number, and in Rossi's account Lorentz reworked them into a simpler form. Rossi, a man who says aliens taught him advanced physics, tells this to Michels without naming a source, as a point where he believes part of Maxwell's original physics was lost.
